description: A standing order makes a Vlad account pay its agent's bills from its gains each day: creditsPct as AI credits on Raeto (one balance for 400+ models and APIs), at most gasPct to keep the wallet's ETH at gasTargetEth, and the rest in USDG to the wallet. The seed and money added stay locked. Returns the order, whether it is running and what it has paid so far.

agentId.description: The ERC-8004 agentId on Robinhood Chain, as a decimal string or integer.

title: Standing orders: read an account's order
